decisions.quote: This replication study focused on the effectiveness of two different intervention approaches, activity-based intervention and embedded direct instruction, on the acquisition, generalization, and maintenance of phonological awareness, a key area of emergent literacy, by preschool children with language delays. Five male preschool participants with language delay were treated with a modified alternating-treatments design.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state file exists for this work. The supplied primary source (292446349ef54f27.txt) contains only the article title, author list, and abstract from Crossref JATS metadata, with no full text, in-text citations, or reference list. While the abstract explicitly states that this is a replication study comparing activity-based intervention and embedded direct instruction in five preschool children with language delays, it does not name or cite the original study being replicated, leaving all bibliographic fields of the blind candidate empty. Consequently, the available source evidence cannot settle the unresolved question of which specific published study is empirically retested in the full text and whether that target is already represented by shipped row 2529 (Losardo & Bricker, 1994, 'Activity-based intervention and direct instruction: a comparison study', doi_o: NA) or is a distinct unshipped original work.
